title: schizoloma retusum
intro: Schizoloma retusum, commonly known as the mountain fern or Schizoloma, is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the reduction of inflammation, improvement of digestive issues, and antimicrobial properties. Schizoloma retusum is also used for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
